ClinicalDocument.title: SYNTHETIC RECORD, NOT A REAL MEDICAL RECORD — Progress Note 6 — Focused Visit (Follow-up) — Sonny Liston — True-date frame: synthetic events are moved into the patient's historical lifetime. Codes, instruments, and treatments remain modern and are anachronistic.

code.originalText: Three-month review: blood pressure, liver tests and drinking on naltrexone

text.paragraph: Three-month review of blood pressure and drinking. [S]

Sonny Liston returns two weeks after a cold, for which he stopped an over-the-counter decongestant; his home readings came back down within two days and have averaged 124/78 mmHg over the past week. He takes amlodipine 10 mg and valsartan 160 mg and naltrexone 50 mg each morning. Mild ankle swelling after long runs in the heat goes by morning. He drinks three or four drinks on one or two evenings a week and has not had more than four on any day since starting naltrexone; the urge to keep going is much weaker. He saw the dentist about his molar. He wants to start sparring hard again. No thoughts of suicide. [S]
